sla_policy: UNKNOWN until Warmbly #55 measures a representative baseline. No invented prazo.

first_canary.question: Qual e o valor tipico dos contratos publicos de pavimentacao?
first_canary.secondary_cta: Peca uma segunda leitura de contrato

opt_in_issue_90.rule: ainda_nao_pronto may offer citation or download only. No digest, newsletter or opt-in until #90 is authorized.

agenda.reason: no public booking route with owner and measured latency

routes.eligibility: Public Market Answer or Contract Analysis is visible. Visitor wants method, sample, limits or evidence. No commercial urgency claimed.
routes.promised_outcome: Explorar evidencia, metodo, cobertura e limitacoes da resposta publica. Nao e diagnostico da empresa do visitante.
routes.privacy_consent: Nenhum dado pessoal. Nenhum opt-in. Resposta permanece publica sem lead gate.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if the CTA hides the answer, invents coverage, or converts a learning intent into a coercive form.

routes.eligibility: A public contract or analysis is in context (Market Answer drill-down or #83 page). Visitor wants technical reading, not a company X-Ray.
routes.promised_outcome: Analise tecnica editorial ou segunda leitura humana do contrato em contexto. Fatos, inferencias e UNKNOWN permanecem separados.
routes.privacy_consent: Public contract id only to open the analysis. Name, contact and consent only if the visitor asks for a human second reading.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if the route treats a public analysis as a customer case, or requires a lead to read published facts.

routes.eligibility: Market Answer canary is on screen. Visitor wants to see the informed CNPJ in that market. extra-cli Goal 03 payload or labeled fixture.
routes.promised_outcome: B2G X-Ray factual: carteira publica observada, orgaos, UFs, contratos e limites. Sem score de risco, dor ou irregularidade. Sem diagnostico automatico.
routes.privacy_consent: CNPJ is asked only to locate public-contract observations. Why and what-will-be-shown are on the field. CNPJ is not placed in URL, analytics or unnecessary logs. Name, contact and consent are not asked at this step.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if X-Ray emits risk/credit/pain scores, hides the Market Answer, invents SLA, or gates the public answer behind a lead.

routes.eligibility: Visitor wants a human review of their own contract or a second reading after X-Ray/Analysis. Document is required only when this route is chosen.
routes.promised_outcome: Defesa de Margem / Analise Meu Contrato: persist-first hand-raise for a human technical reading. No automatic legal conclusion.
routes.privacy_consent: Explicit consent required. Purpose: retorno comercial e leitura tecnica solicitada. No nurture, no newsletter, no auto-send.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if the route auto-messages, invents prazo, or treats an incomplete X-Ray as a discovered problem.

routes.eligibility: Visitor states a live operational pressure AND an owned channel exists (WhatsApp/phone catalog). Agenda is not offered because no booking route exists.
routes.promised_outcome: Falar com especialista pela rota operacional existente (WhatsApp ou ligacao). Sem prazo prometido. Sem agenda publica.
routes.privacy_consent: Clicking WhatsApp is a visitor-initiated channel. A persist-first hand-raise is used only if they also submit name/contact/consent. No auto-send.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if the route offers agenda, invented SLA, or a channel without an owner.

routes.eligibility: Visitor wants to leave with the answer, citation or download. #90 Market Signals Brief is not authorized.
routes.promised_outcome: Citation text and/or download of the public answer. No form. No opt-in. No digest.
routes.privacy_consent: No personal data. Opt-in blocked until issue #90 is authorized.
routes.kill_gate: Kill if this route captures email, starts nurture, or pretends #90 is live.
